evals.name: cleanup-formatting-structure
evals.prompt: One of our Series B portfolio companies sent over their financial model and it's a bit of a mess. Can you clean it up so it looks investor-ready? The file is gigafactory_messy.xlsx.
evals.expected_output: A cleaned .xlsx: 10pt Arial throughout, hardcodes in blue / formulas in black / cross-tab links in green, a centralized Control assumptions tab with the duplicated inputs lifted into it, a Notes tab, and a written summary of what changed and what still needs sources. Original file untouched.

evals.name: add-unit-economics-breakeven
evals.prompt: This gigafactory model (gigafactory_messy.xlsx) shows revenue and gross profit but I can't see the unit economics or how much cushion they have on utilization. Can you build out a proper per-unit economics breakdown and add a utilization breakeven?
evals.expected_output: A per-kWh (or per-line) unit economics block (revenue, variable cost, contribution, margin %), a utilization breakeven with the cushion stated (assumed util minus breakeven), and capex intensity/payback where possible. Inputs wired to a centralized assumptions tab; invented numbers avoided (gaps marked for the founder).
